L'''''o'''''jban (pronounced as [ˈloʒban]) is a new cool world language.
== Lojban, the Odyssey to our Universe. ==
What is unique about this language?
*'''Lojban''' changes your mind while you are talking in it.
*'''Lojban''' penetrates into the essence of phenomena like nothing else.
*'''Lojban''' allows you to see the world brighter.
====Lojban is an endless journey.====

Being carefully worked-out in design by it's creators this language accurately and precisely reveals the delicate aspects of logic and our mentality.

=== Clean, simple, and with all these advantages powerful. ===

1. Easy to learn - the number of root word is 4-5 times fewer than in English.

2. You can talk in a concisely manner:

✔ "co'e" (pronounced as "sho-heh") in Lojban means "thinkamagic/crap/any object" '''<nowiki> ;) </nowiki>'''.

✔ "se catlu" (pronounced as "seh shatlooh") - all that can be looked at: a face, a mountain landscape, the book.

3. Lojban breaks the barrier of misunderstanding of people with different background.

This website is the main place where all the information on Lojban is presented for free public access.
